events.outcome: Taiwan Mobile current regular 4G/5G prepaid tariff material includes standard NT$300 prepaid number-card products. Cheaper child, OK, light-data and short-term tourist variants are separate named products and are not used as the normalized acquisition baseline for this general long-term route.

Current Taiwan Mobile prepaid communication-credit recharge material includes an NT$100 recharge denomination and states that number validity restarts for six months from the recharge date. This establishes a lowest documented retention action of NT$100 every 180 days, about NT$200/year.

Taiwan Mobile currently supports eSIM for Taiwan Mobile prepaid users through physical stores; prepaid eSIM change/setup fees are deducted from prepaid balance. The page excludes legacy original Taiwan Star prepaid users, which does not change the Taiwan Mobile prepaid route identity.

Foreign applicants must use a physical myfone store and provide two original identity documents. Taiwan Mobile states that prepaid applicants are assigned either a short-validity card or a regular prepaid card according to the validity of their permitted stay in Taiwan. Online application is unavailable to international customers. Therefore passport acceptance alone does not guarantee eligibility for the long-term general-prepaid route.

Taiwan Mobile prepaid roaming explicitly states that in China the prepaid line does not provide roaming voice calling or outgoing SMS, but can receive SMS, excluding paid/premium SMS. Voice roaming must be enabled and device/network VoLTE conditions may apply. This is ordinary incoming-SMS entitlement, not an app/bank OTP delivery guarantee.

data.tariffSummary: Standard regular prepaid baseline NT$300. General prepaid validity is six months and each recharge restarts six months; current communication-credit recharge includes NT$100, implying about NT$200/year for retention. Physical SIM + eSIM supported through Taiwan stores. China prepaid roaming permits incoming ordinary SMS but not voice or outgoing SMS.
guideSteps: Before purchase, confirm your Taiwan stay-document validity qualifies you for a regular general prepaid card rather than a non-extendable short-term tourist card.
Apply in person at a Taiwan Mobile myfone store with two original identity documents; international customers cannot use the standard online application flow.
Choose physical SIM or Taiwan Mobile prepaid eSIM where supported; eSIM handling remains a store process for prepaid users.
Recharge at least NT$100 before each 180-day deadline to restart number validity for six months.
For China use, enable the required prepaid roaming/VoLTE conditions and rely only on ordinary incoming SMS entitlement; do not assume outgoing SMS, voice roaming or app/bank OTP success.
